Question 1 shaded-f · r2

12 points2.5 planned minuteseasy
Two of the five equal cells are shaded. Select all true statements about the shaded fraction \( p \).
  1. ✓
    \( p = 0.4 \)
    Two divided by five is 0.4.
  2. ✗
    \( p = \frac{3}{5} \)
    This is the unshaded fraction.
  3. ✓
    \( p + (1-p) = 1 \)
    The two fractions cover the whole.
  4. ✗
    \( p = 0 \)
    Two cells are shaded.
  5. ✗
    \( p > 1 \)
    A fraction of these cells cannot exceed one.

Question 2 quadrati · r2

24 points5 planned minuteshard
For \( f(x) = x^2 \), select all true statements.
  1. ✓
    \( f(0) = 0 \)
    Zero squared is zero.
  2. ✓
    \( f(3) = 9 \)
    Three squared is nine.
  3. ✗
    \( f(-3) = -9 \)
    A negative number squared is positive.
  4. ✓
    \( f^{\prime}(x) = 2x \)
    Apply the power rule.
  5. ✗
    The function is linear.
    It is quadratic.
